title: scenarios: a recorded masking-off ask round, so the ruled field-level-security question can be asked on the open cards
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cypybwgoxE3ZMZy8kt

Filed by area a4-B on seat 4's routing (2026-11-21 12:19Z), out of #35113's build (PR #36065). Not claimed.

## Why

The ruled `forbidden` question for field-level security (#35113 comment 6979780844) runs as "a caller who sees the whole schema (an ADR-0106 D4-exempt user) or on a deployment with schema masking off (D8): that caller asks for the withheld field, and \"not visible to you\" passes while \"blank\" or \"empty\" fails." #35179 shipped the framework half. The open runner cannot ask it yet: every card persona is a plain member (create-user role `user`) on a default, schema-masked `objectstack dev`. For them the withheld field does not exist, which, per the same comment, "is not this question". The existing withheld grader already passes a "not visible to you" decline and fails "blank", so only the round configuration is missing.

## Scope

- A runner flag that boots the host with schema masking off (`OS_ALLOW_UNMASKED_OBJECT_METADATA=1`, read by `packages/metadata-core`'s `OBJECT_SCHEMA_MASK_DISABLE_ENV`), stamped on the round's record, so a masking-off round is a recorded configuration.
- `summary` refuses to mix masking-off and default rounds in one reading.
- On that round, the cards' existing member-withheld field questions (e.g. `department_budgets` asked as `employee`) are the FLS question. No new question is needed.

## Done when

1. The runner refuses, or records on the round, `OS_ALLOW_UNMASKED_OBJECT_METADATA` when it is set in the environment without the flag. Today the runner passes its whole environment to `objectstack dev` (`subscriptionOnlyEnv` strips only billing variables), so an operator who exports it runs an unrecorded masking-off round.
2. A masking-off round over the dataset cards grades the member-withheld field questions: "not visible to you" passes, "blank"/"empty" fails, and the record says masking was off.
3. The default daily round stays byte-identical.

## Alternatives not taken

- A D4-exempt persona inside the default round (the runner grants one persona `manage_metadata` through a runner-owned permission set). This is a larger seeding change, it means re-verifying `travel_expense`'s build, and it may widen that persona beyond reads.
- Leaving the question to the hosted set only. Then the FLS answer stays unmeasured in the open repo.

## Relations

- From #35113 (comment 6979780844); PR #36065. Framework half: #35137 / PR #35179. Parent epic: #35154.
- Dedup: searched `scenarios masking off round OS_ALLOW_UNMASKED_OBJECT_METADATA` — 2 hits (#35113, #33829 a QA run record), no duplicate.
